run.prompt: Enrich this CRM account into a current company profile. Resolve the company from its domain (eve.legal), not its name: several unrelated companies are called Eve. Use the company's own website, newsroom and careers/ATS pages first for identity, products, headquarters, leadership and hiring. Use press releases and reputable business or legal-industry news for funding and recent announcements. Treat data aggregators (Crunchbase, Tracxn, PitchBook, GetLatka, CB Insights) as secondary corroboration only. When sources disagree on a field, pick the best-supported value, and record the disagreement in data_conflicts. Leave a field null rather than guess.

products: EveOS (AI operating system for plaintiff law)

content.vertical: Legal Tech — AI software for plaintiff law firms
content.last_round: Series B, $103M at $1B+ post-money valuation, September 30, 2025, led by Spark Capital
content.description: Eve is the AI-native platform (EveOS) for plaintiff law firms, automating and assisting with end-to-end casework — from intake and medical chronologies to drafting, demand letters, discovery, and trial — used by 1,200+ plaintiff-side law firms.
content.customer_count: 1,200+ plaintiff law firms (as of October 2026, per company website)

data_conflicts.resolution: Use 2023 as public-launch / first-funding year (Oct 25, 2023 seed round) since company emerged from stealth that month; 2020 is when the founding team began working together but no public company existed yet.
data_conflicts.values_found: 2020 (per Lightspeed: 'we first met Jay, Matt and David back in 2020'; Tracxn/GetLatka) vs 2023 (per company public launch from stealth October 25, 2023 on PR Newswire)

data_conflicts.resolution: Use San Mateo, California based on a specific physical address from CB Insights and confirmed by multiple aggregators; SF is the company's media framing and where their Series B press was issued. Greenhouse shows both offices are hybrid.
data_conflicts.values_found: San Mateo, California (per CB Insights physical address 71 East 3rd Avenue; GetLatka; Greenhouse / Lever has San Mateo AND San Francisco hybrid roles) vs San Francisco, California (per PR Newswire Sept 30 2025 Series B dateline; Crunchbase; Tracxn; LSVP; Law.com)

data_conflicts.resolution: Use 1,200+ firms as of October 2026 (most recent statement on company home page); cite progression in recent_signals.
data_conflicts.values_found: 450 firms (Sep 30 2025, PR Newswire); ~700-900 firms (Mar 10 2026 Eve AI Workforce GA per PR Newswire title); 1,000 firms (Apr 7 2026 Tort Report); 1,200+ firms (Oct 7 2026 home page)

data_conflicts.resolution: Use 376 employees as of August 31 2026 (more recent Tracxn aggregation) with as-of date stamp.
data_conflicts.values_found: 174 (GetLatka, Dec 2025, LinkedIn-derived) vs 376 (Tracxn, Aug 31 2026). Greenhouse shows 20 active listings, consistent with active hiring.
